content.title: PBKS vs SRH Live Cricket Score, IPL 2026: Shreyas Iyer leads from the front as Punjab Kings trounce Sunrisers Hyderabad by 6 wickets in Mullanpur
content.text: PBKS vs SRH Live Cricket Score: The IPL 2026 is in full swing and it is the doubleheader today. In the afternoon match-up, Punjab Kings will take on Sunrisers Hyderabad at the PCA New Stadium in Chandigarh. PBKS are undefeated after the first three games, whereas SRH have lost two of the three they have played. However, as the nature of the league is quite unpredictable, any team can beat any team on any given day.Punjab Kings will rely on the opening pair of Priyansh Arya and Prabhsimran Singh to give them a good start. Given the form he is in, they will expect captain Iyer to score in every game, and whenever he gets runs the chances of PBKS' win increases. They have capable all-rounders like Marco Jansen and Marcus Stoinis in the squad as well. When it comes to bowling, they have veterans like Arshdeep Singh and Yuzvendra Chahal in the team. Also, Vijaykumar Vyshak and Xavier Bartlett have been quite successful with the ball till now.Sunrisers Hyderabad on the other end will bank on the destructive opening pair of Abhishek Sharma and Travis Head. They have the likes of Ishan Kishan, Heinrich Klaasen, and Nitish Kumar Reddy in the squad as well, strengthening batting. Bowling has been their major concern till now and the onus will be on Jaidev Unadkat and Eshan Malinga.Considering the world-class players present in both squads, a thrilling contest is expected to take place.Punjab Kings: Prabhsimran Singh (wk), Priyansh Arya, Cooper Connolly, Shreyas Iyer (c), Shashank Singh, Marcus Stoinis, Marco Jansen, Xavier Bartlett, Vijaykumar Vyshak, Arshdeep Singh, Yuzvendra ChahalImpact Player options: Nehal Wadhera, Vishnu Vinod, Suryansh Shedge, Yash Thakur, Harpreet BrarSunrisers Hyderabad: Abhishek Sharma, Travis Head, Ishan Kishan (wk, c), Heinrich Klaasen, Salil Arora, Aniket Verma, Nitish Kumar Reddy, Harsh Dubey, Shivang Kumar, Harshal Patel, Eshan MalingaImpact Player options: Jaydev Unadkat, Praful Hinge, Liam Livingstone, Shivam Mavi, Kamindu Mendis
